1001 albums, one after another

About 15 years ago I bought a book in Brazil called 1001 Albums You Must Hear Before You Die: albums from the 1950s through the 2000s, each with a short text about what makes it special and why it matters. This site is my way of finally working through it, one album at a time, and you are welcome to join me.

        💡 Have a subscription but still hear ads or only short previews? How to fix it

        Your browser stops YouTube and Spotify from recognising your account inside another site. You allow it once, for this site only:

        On a computer (Chrome)
        1. Copy the settings address: chrome://settings/cookies
        2. Open a new tab, paste it into the address bar and press Enter.
        3. Next to “Sites allowed to use third-party cookies” click “Add” and paste this site’s address: sdhdavid.github.io
        4. Make sure you are signed in to YouTube or Spotify in the same browser, then refresh the page.
        On Android (Chrome)
        1. Menu ⋮ → Settings → Site settings → Third-party cookies.
        2. Add an exception and paste this site’s address: sdhdavid.github.io
        On iPhone and iPad

        Apple blocks this in every browser. The simplest thing is to press “Open on YouTube” or “Open in Spotify”, and the album opens in the app with your subscription.

        This is a demo of the English version: only the first 3 albums of the book are translated so far. Numbers and order follow the book’s list. You can listen in the YouTube or the Spotify player; your choice is saved in the browser. For some albums the tracks are numbered by playlist order; for a few others the album is shown as one continuous recording. Availability of recordings may vary by region and YouTube permissions.
